gzip -dc /Volumes/CMS_SSD_2TB/R_scRNAseq/2019_SLE_LN/data/Sequencing_data/hg38_CR7_wo_introns/GEX/Pat4_rep1_blood/outs/mhc_reads_bamboozled.fastq.gz | awk '
BEGIN {
    headers = "gzip -1 -c > headers.txt.gz"
    sequences = "gzip -1 -c > sequences.txt.gz"
    qualities = "gzip -1 -c > qualities.txt.gz"
}
{
    print | headers
    getline
    print | sequences
    getline
    getline
    print | qualities
}
END {
    close(headers)
    close(sequences)
    close(qualities)
}'

pigz -dc /Volumes/CMS_SSD_2TB/R_scRNAseq/2019_SLE_LN/data/Sequencing_data/hg38_CR7_wo_introns/GEX/Pat4_rep1_blood/outs/mhc_reads_bamboozled.fastq.gz | awk '
BEGIN {
    headers = "pigz -1 -p 2 -c > headers.txt.gz"
    sequences = "pigz -1 -p 2 -c > sequences.txt.gz"
    qualities = "pigz -1 -p 2 -c > qualities.txt.gz"
}
{
    print | headers
    getline
    print | sequences
    getline
    getline
    print | qualities
}
END {
    close(headers)
    close(sequences)
    close(qualities)
}'


## bamtofastq from 10X

# For ordinary BAM-to-FASTQ conversion, use samtools fastq. For reconstructing FASTQs from supported 10x Genomics BAMs, use 10x’s bamtofastq. The name bamtofastq is ambiguous: BEDTools and biobambam2 also have tools with that name.
# For 10x single-cell RNA-seq, the distinction matters: barcode and UMI information can be stored in BAM tags rather than as a separate read alignment. Plain samtools fastq extraction does not automatically reconstruct the 10x FASTQ layout. Use 10x bamtofastq when preparing inputs to rerun Cell Ranger; the required tags must still be present. V(D)J BAMs are an explicit unsupported case.

curl -fL \
  https://github.com/10XGenomics/bamtofastq/releases/download/v1.4.1/bamtofastq_macos \
  -o bamtofastq

chmod +x bamtofastq

./bamtofastq --help

./bamtofastq --nthreads=8 --reads-per-fastq=500000000000 /Volumes/CMS_SSD_2TB/R_scRNAseq/2019_SLE_LN/data/Sequencing_data/hg38_CR7_wo_introns/GEX/Pat4_rep1_blood/outs/possorted_genome_bam.bam fastq_out




## snps from bam
# bcf tools

bcftools mpileup -Ou -f /Volumes/CMS_SSD_2TB/reference_genomes/refdata-gex-GRCh38-2020-A/fasta/genome.fa /Volumes/CMS_SSD_2TB/R_scRNAseq/2019_SLE_LN/data/Sequencing_data/hg38_CR7_wo_introns/GEX/Pat4_rep1_blood/outs/possorted_genome_bam.bam \
  | bcftools call -mv -Ou \
  | bcftools norm -m -any -Ou \
  | bcftools view -v snps -Oz -o snps.vcf.gz
  
bcftools query -f '%CHROM\t%POS\t%REF\t%ALT\n' /Users/chris/snps.vcf.gz > snps.tsv
